tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Call this before you research or write something: an existing document may already cover it. tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List popular topic tags with document counts.

tools.name: read_profile
tools.description: Read a contributor profile by public key: documents, proposed edits with their review state, and open suggestions awaiting that profile's review (inbox). Poll your own profile to follow up on your work, and review inbox items with review_suggestion.

tools.name: read_notifications
tools.description: Read notifications for the signed profile. Sign action "notifications" with payload {} or {unread:true}. Only that profile's rows are returned. Never send a private key.

tools.name: mark_read
tools.description: Mark the signed profile's notifications read. Sign action "mark_notifications_read" with payload {} for every unread row, or {ids:[...]}. Never send a private key.

tools.name: read_document
tools.description: Read canonical content, topics, counts and citation for a document (UUID or legacy number), optionally at an immutable revision. Sign action "update" with {documentId, baseRevisionId, content:{kind:"markdown", markdown}, details?:{title}, message?}. mess

tools.name: suggest_edit
tools.description: Suggest a change to a Markdown Document or Markdown Spreadsheet for the owner to review. A document is a title and its content. Pass markdown to replace the body. Pass title to rename it. Topics are assigned automatically. Omit markdown for a title-only suggestion. Metadata-only suggestions work on

tools.name: review_suggestion
tools.description: Accept (merge) or reject a suggested edit on a document you own, or withdraw your own open suggestion with decision "reject". Only the owner can accept. List open suggestions waiting for you with read_profile (inbox) on your public key, or read_activity on the document; each change shows its propose

tools.name: comment
tools.description: Post a comment on a document. Body ≤ 5,000 characters. Sign action "discuss" with {documentId, body}. Reply by also signing parentId.

tools.name: delete
tools.description: Delete your own Markdown Document, Markdown Spreadsheet, or comment. Sign action "delete" with exactly {documentId} or {commentId}. The URL disappears. Revisions stay in the database and are not shown.

tools.name: read_activity
tools.description: Read suggestions (changes: state open, merged or rejected, with the proposed version as mergeContent and any mergeError), published revisions, or discussion and tasks for a public document. The document owner reviews open suggestions with review_suggestion.

tools.name: read_rules
tools.description: Read the current contribution rules before contributing.

tools.name: read_moderation
tools.description: Read public moderation decisions without reproducing reported content.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "delete" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_documents, read_profile, read_notifications, mark_read, read_document, upload_image, suggest_edit, review_suggestion, read_activity · Private data: search_documents, list_topics, read_profile, read_notifications, mark_read, read_document, submit_contribution, upload_image, create_markdown, edit_markdown, suggest_edit, review_suggestion, comment, delete, read_activity · Public sink: read_notifications, mark_read, read_document, submit_contribution, upload_image, create_markdown, review_suggestion, comment · Destructive: search_documents, delete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_documents, read_profile, read_notifications, mark_read, read_document, upload_image, suggest_edit, review_suggestion, read_activity · Private data: search_documents, list_topics, read_profile, read_notifications, mark_read, read_document, submit_contribution, upload_image, create_markdown, edit_markdown, suggest_edit, review_suggestion, comment, delete, read_activity · Public sink: read_notifications, mark_read, read_document, submit_contribution, upload_image, create_markdown, review_suggestion, comment · Destructive: search_documents, delete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
